prompts.study: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background art for an actual premium browser detective word game, not an interface mockup. Use the attached concept only as a MATERIAL AND LIGHTING reference. Produce ONE full-bleed photographic game background at the highest supported quality and highest native resolution, landscape 16:9. No borders, no UI, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no symbols that resemble writing. Rich ink-blue and very dark teal detective study at night. Left 52 percent: quiet, very dark soft-focus library wall and clear desk space, suitable for live cream title/buttons to be overlaid later. Right 48 percent: a luxurious closed charcoal-leather case folder standing slightly diagonally on the desk, thin matte brass corner fittings, a small deep red unlettered wax seal attached to a simple cord across the folio; a warm brass desk lamp above right illuminates the folio's paper edges. The folio is a sealed mystery, entirely unmarked; no repeated ring of gold disks. Foreground subtle deep teal leather desk surface; one tasteful magnifying glass at lower right, mostly within right half. Soft shelves in the distance, no readable book titles. Cinematic warm spot lighting, refined understated matte brass, fine tactile leather, delicate paper fibers, rich shadows. Avoid placing bright details or strong light in the left half. Coherent physically plausible perspective and material craft. No people, no characters, no animals, no secret answer or clue. No generated UI labels, screenshots, buttons, panel borders or logos. Highest native resolution, maximum detail and quality.
prompts.button: Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE production game UI BUTTON SKIN as a single isolated transparent PNG image, with genuine alpha transparency outside the button. Highest supported native resolution and maximum supported quality. Wide landscape composition approximately 3:1. This asset will be used as the background of a real HTML button, with live text overlaid separately. The attached concept is material/style reference only, not an edit target. Create a straight-on perfectly symmetrical horizontal matte brass plaque button for a sophisticated detective study game: refined chamfered corners, thin layered charcoal/antique-brass edge, slim brushed gold beveled rim, warm pale matte brass inset surface, very fine natural grain, subtle embossed seam, a tiny restrained round rivet at each end. Central 75 percent must remain plain, clean, evenly lit warm brass for dark readable live button text. The object fills 96 percent canvas width and 76 percent canvas height, centered. Upper-left warm light, short soft underside shadow included with alpha. No perspective, no tilt, no desk, no hands, no interface screenshot, no other objects. Absolutely NO text, glyphs, letters, numbers, symbols, title or watermark. NO white background, no baked checkerboard. Luxurious coherent craftsmanship with fine real material detail rather than noisy engraving. Keep border lines clean and consistent in thickness; enough restraint for a touch button at 300 by 70 pixels.
prompts.paper: Use case: ui-mockup. One production textless PARCHMENT RECORD PANEL asset for a premium detective-study browser game, with real alpha transparency around the panel. Highest supported native resolution, maximum supported quality. Portrait composition approximately 4:5. The attached concept is a material/style reference only. One perfectly front-facing rectangular panel centered, occupying 96% width and 96% height. A very thin dark ink-teal leather outer frame, fine antique matte-brass line accents with restrained chamfered corners, inside is warm light ivory archival paper (#F2E9D8) with delicate authentic fibers and barely visible warm edge aging. Keep the central 85% very quiet, evenly light, high contrast for dark text that will be rendered separately in code. Elegant tiny corner line details only, no ornate scrolls. Physically consistent rim depth and upper-left lighting, subtle short shadow on transparent outside. Seamless clean straight border lines and consistent thickness. No content: absolutely no lettering, numbers, stamps, symbols, writing, ruled lines, watermarks, app mockup, titles, or other objects. No perspective skew, no severe dirt or tear effects, no white background or checkerboard. This is a functional high-end game inventory/case-notes panel, reusable for questions, results and rankings.
